title: Taffy
description: A giant song title in ink that pulls like sugar — drag any letter out of the word and it drags against your hand while its strands neck to a hair, then lurches toward your finger as each one snaps, pop, pop, before springing home. Tap the paper and the title melts into the next one from your recently played.
intent: One finished mechanic: letters stretch out of a word on sagging, volume-conserving ink strands that neck before they snap and whip home.
